text: They sometimes ask for that, especially if the contract is only for one of the two occupants. It means the landlord needs to sign a letter in front of a lawyer that states that you actually live there. However, in most cases, that's not exactly realistic, since the landlord has no incentive to spend significant time on meeting lawyers and signing nonsensical documents like that. I think we went with letter and phone number - and after some discussion, they accepted that.
